facts.text: Tim expressed interest in visiting Barcelona and intends to add it to his travel list.

evidence.quote: Barcelona sounds awesome! I've heard so many great things. Definitely adding it to my list.

facts.text: John recommended Barcelona as a must-visit city, highlighting its culture, architecture, food, and nearby beaches.
